prompts.prompt: Write a story of about 300 words about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.
Write a 300-word essay on why cities should plant more trees.
Describe, in about 300 words, a day in the life of a medieval blacksmith.
Write a 300-word letter from a grandmother to her grandson who just started university.
Explain in about 300 words how a bill becomes a law, for a curious teenager.
Write a 300-word travel diary entry about arriving in a small mountain village.
Write a short science-fiction story of about 300 words set on a generation ship.
In about 300 words, argue for and against working from home.
